title: Pool slot fd cleared on acquire protects against concurrent cleanup double-close
description: crypto2dev_pool_acquire sets slot->fd = -1 immediately after leasing the fd to the caller (port.c:284). This means concurrent crypto2dev_pool_cleanup sees -1 and skips the close, preventing double-close of the in-flight fd. A contributor who 'simplifies' the acquire to not clear slot->fd (since the slot is in_use anyway) would reintroduce a race. The invariant: slot->fd is either a ready fd (in_use=0) or -1 (in_use=1 means the caller holds it). The comment at port.c:283-285 explains this but it's easy to miss. Decision: keep the clear.
